facts.fact: Nate 五年来第一次回到 Duck Lake——五年前这里差点要了他的命。
facts.anchor: It was the first time Nate Yellow Tail had been back to Duck Lake since it almost killed him five years ago.

facts.fact: Sebby 没上部落名册是因为他父亲与部落委员会之间的旧纠纷，因此去年满十八岁也没拿到 claim check。
facts.anchor: The reason he wasn’t on the rolls was the usual petty bullshit with his dad and the Council—same old, same old.

facts.fact: 五年前的 Duck Lake 惨案中，Cassidy Sees Elk 用一战步枪射中了 Nate。
facts.anchor: when Cassidy Sees Elk shot Nate with that World War I rifle

facts.fact: D（Denorah Cross Guns）是另一名幸存者；Nate 在 ICU 醒来时她守在床边，那是他第一次听她说脏话，当时他们十四岁。
facts.anchor: “Fuck you, Nate Yellow Tail,” D had whispered, the first cuss words he’d ever heard from her—they were fourteen—

facts.fact: 屋里一张家庭照是印第安母亲和两个小女孩在湖边给充气筏充气——Nate 称他们为「Summer Indians」。
facts.anchor: The snapshot was an Indian mom and two young girls. They were trying to launch a blow-up raft onto the lake, and having no end of fun doing it.

facts.fact: Nate 在屋外看到两只小得反常的鹿在雪地里拱雪。
facts.anchor: It was two tiny deer nosing at the snow just in front of that grabby red bush he’d heard called buckbrush.

facts.fact: 返程时一辆碎石卡车撞上 Sebby 的车，把他们撞进树林。
facts.anchor: the gravel truck barreling down the road slammed into the driver’s-side door, sent them spinning into the trees
